title: Joe Howard, the trumpeter who taught Punch
summary: Punch says Joe Howard showed him a lot on trumpet before he left New Orleans, and learns Howard has died.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Joe Howard used to be a trumpet player, but tell me he got on bass. But I can say this. Before I left here, Joe Howard showed me a whole lot of stuff on trumpet. And gave me a whole lot of musical ideas. He was a mighty fine man, boy. And to tell me he plays tuba now, I don't know. He's dead. Since I've been back. Why does he live? I want to. He's dead. He's dead. No, I didn't know that. I didn't know that.
